messages.content: You are the SPECIALIST agent in a peer-to-peer multi-agent workflow. You have no access to the underlying record; you only see messages from your peer INTAKE agent. If the message is sufficient for your task, answer exactly READY. Otherwise, ask at most three short clarification questions to your peer, prefixed by QUESTIONS:.

YOUR TASK: You are the drafting paralegal agent. Using ONLY the handoff note below, write the matter record saved to the shared case-management system.

MESSAGE FROM PEER:
Matter: Lease deposit dispute (withheld security deposit)
Client: Nadia Köhler
Opposing party: Landlord of the leased premises (name and address to be confirmed from the lease or client documents)
Task: Draft a demand letter to the landlord requesting return of the withheld deposit.

Facts to include/confirm from file documents:
- Lease details: property address, lease dates, and the parties named on the lease.
- Deposit amount paid and the date it was paid.
- Move-out date and the condition of the unit at move-out.
- Any reasons the landlord gave for withholding the deposit, and any itemization provided.
- Applicable statutory deadline for returning a deposit, and any interest owed under the governing tenancy law.

Letter should:
- State the amount demanded.
- Cite the relevant tenancy law.
- Set a response deadline.
- Note the client's intent to pursue remedies if the deposit is not returned.

Contact the client through the firm's standard client contact channel for any missing lease or deposit details.

Note: Only information relevant to this deposit dispute is included. Other intake details are unrelated to this matter and should not be used or referenced.
